name: JTF_RS_CHGD_ROLE_RELATIONS
description: This table stores the relations between Groups. Primary key is Group_relate_id. Ex. for relation_type is 'PARENT_GROUP' (Similar to JTF_RS_GRP_RELATIONS with a OPERATION_FLAG Column added)

columns.name: ROLE_RESOURCE_TYPE
columns.description: Resource Type for the corresponding Role.

columns.name: ROLE_RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Resource Identifier for the corresponding role.

columns.name: START_DATE_ACTIVE
columns.description: Effective Start date of the role relation.

columns.name: END_DATE_ACTIVE
columns.description: Effective end date of the role relation.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
